capabilities: Review CriticMarkup marks in a side panel
Insert and mark CriticMarkup from commands or the right-click menu
disambiguation: Not version history or file diffing; it only reviews CriticMarkup marks written into note text.
extras: The referenced Claude Code agent plugin is third-party and not maintained by this project; a minimal reviewer skill is provided in docs/SKILL.md.
motivation: Built for AI-assisted review, so marks an agent leaves in a note can be reviewed in one place.
problem: Suggested edits and comments written as CriticMarkup stay as raw markup in the note, with no in-app way to review, accept or discuss them.
summary: Side panel for reviewing CriticMarkup suggestions in notes, with accept, reject, threaded replies and a vault-wide pending list.
